name: unhcr-refugee-data-finder

persistence_momentum.definition: score = log_growth_d = ln(apps_d+1)-ln(apps_d1+1), the corridor's own last-step growth observed at the instant (the most recent observed analogue)
persistence_momentum.note: rank reference; Brier needs calibrated probabilities which a growth score is not

persistence_surge_flag.definition: score = surged_recently = apps_d >= 2 x apps_d1: did the corridor already double into year D?

calendar_identity.definition: train-estimated positive rate per (origin, asylum) corridor, per-origin fallback, global train-rate fallback; identity-only prior from training rows

recent_rate.definition: constant train positive rate over the last three train label-years [2014, 2015, 2016]: the era-drift analogue for a task with no same-entity persistence at a longer horizon

majority_class.definition: majority label fitted on train, measured against this split's labels

momentum_vs_calendar_identity.note: paired row bootstrap on identical eval rows; an interval containing zero is an inconclusive difference, not parity

surge_flag_vs_calendar_identity.note: paired row bootstrap on identical eval rows; an interval containing zero is an inconclusive difference, not parity

interpretation_note: one weak or strong reference does not establish the task's usefulness or impossibility; the full model is the harness runner's job and its figure is quoted beside these when it exists. The holdout is sealed until the design is frozen.
